pairs.question: et in medio eorum erat iuvenis statura celsus, eminentior omnibus illis, et singulis eorum capitibus inponebat coronas, et magis exaltabatur; ego autem miraculo tenebar. qui sunt hii, domine?
pairs.answer: hii sunt qui mortalem tunicam deposuerunt et inmortalem sumpserunt et confessi sunt nomen Dei; modo coronantur et accipiunt palmas.
pairs.derivation: Ezra asks the angel about the crowned crowd; included v.43 as verbatim setup so 'hii' has a referent (the throng being crowned by the youth). Dropped the speech tag 'tunc interrogavi angelum et dixi:' before the question and 'qui respondens dixit mihi:' before the answer. Answer is the angel's single sentence, ending at its first full stop ('accipiunt palmas.'); nothing further follows in v.45.

pairs.question: ille iuvenis quis est, qui eis coronas inponit et palmas in manus tradit?
pairs.answer: ipse est Filius Dei, quem in saeculo confessi sunt.
pairs.derivation: Ezra asks who the youth is; dropped speech tags 'et dixi ad angelum:' and 'qui respondens dixit mihi:'. Answer stops at the first full stop; the following 'ego autem magnificare eos coepi...' is Ezra's own narration, not part of the angel's reply, so it is cut.

pairs.question: vade et interroga praegnantem, si quando impleverit novem menses suos, adhuc poterit matrix eius retinere fetus in semet ipsa?
pairs.derivation: The angel poses the question (can the womb still hold the fetus after nine months?); Ezra answers it directly. Dropped framing 'et respondit ad me et dixit:' before the question and 'et dixi:' before the answer. Cut at Ezra's full stop; the angel's next sentence 'in inferno promptuaria animarum matrici adsimilata sunt' begins the application and is not part of the answer.

pairs.question: quae erit separatio temporum, aut quando prioris finis aut sequentis initium?
pairs.answer: ab Abraham usque ad Abraham, quoniam ab eo natus est Iacob et Esau, manus enim Iacob tenebat ab initio calcaneum Esau.
pairs.derivation: Ezra asks about the division of the ages; dropped 'et respondi et dixi:' and 'et dixit ad me:'. Answer ends at the first full stop ('calcaneum Esau.'); v.9-10 ('finis enim huius saeculi Esau...') elaborate and are cut.

pairs.question: ergo dabitur tempus animabus, postquam separatae fuerint de corporibus, ut videant de quo mihi dixisti?
pairs.answer: septem diebus erit libertas earum, ut videant in septem diebus qui praedicti sunt sermones, et postea congregabuntur in habitaculis suis.
pairs.derivation: Ezra asks whether the souls are given time after death to see what was described; the angel answers concretely (seven days). Dropped 'et respondi et dixi:' and 'et dixit mihi:'. Answer is the single sentence to its full stop.

pairs.question: si inveni gratiam ante oculos tuos, demonstra mihi adhuc servo tuo, si in die iudicii iusti impios excusare poterint vel deprecari pro eis Altissimum, si patres pro filiis vel filii pro parentibus, si fratres pro fratribus, si adfines pro proximis, si fidentes pro carissimis.
pairs.answer: sic numquam nemo pro aliquo rogabit; omnes enim portabunt unusquisque tunc iniustitias suas aut iustitias.
pairs.derivation: Ezra's whole plea is one extended question (will the just be able to plead for the impious at judgment?); quoted contiguous and entire, dropping only 'et respondi et dixi:'. The reply opens with non-answering preamble ('quoniam invenisti gratiam... et hoc tibi demonstrabo. dies iudicii audax est... quemadmodum nunc non mittit pater filium...'); advanced the answer's start past that analogy to the operative answering sentence 'sic numquam nemo pro aliquo rogabit...', which directly states no one will plead for another.
